calibration.method: shared multi-episode metric reprojection fit with CAD and measured mat dimensions

external_camera_constraint.method: independent optical pose/lens fit to mat, box corners and curved near-wall seam
uncertainties: Hand-located corners, approximately 2 px; partly occluded front corner downweighted
Metric enclosure/mat dimensions and optional known-size stereo plates; optics/pose remain image-derived
Pixel alignment estimate, not a measured metric camera calibration
external_camera_constraint.lens_source: independent external-lens fit; wrist-camera estimate used only as a weak same-model prior

assumptions: Metric scale comes from enclosure/mat and CAD dimensions
No per-frame camera, robot or motor correction; last two episodes held out
Visible cream outline and tip measurements have occlusion/segmentation uncertainty
Hardware normalization verified against saved follower/leader calibrations; physical CAD zeros and contact properties still need geometric/dynamic identification

encoder_scale_constraint.method: supplied LeRobot calibration cross-checked against all recorded encoder values
assumptions: Homing offsets are already applied in motor firmware; never add them to normalized recorded states
Float32 saved actions are recovered on the verified integer leader grid before reproducing follower command truncation

motor_calibration.method: supplied LeRobot calibration cross-checked against all recorded encoder values
notes: Homing offsets are already applied in motor firmware; never add them to normalized recorded states
Arm degree zero is the midpoint of each saved follower range, not encoder tick 2048
The leader gripper spans 1209 ticks and the follower spans 1518; commands are normalized targets sent through follower calibration
Float32 saved actions are recovered on the verified integer leader grid before reproducing follower command truncation
A hand-set homing pose is not a surveyed CAD joint zero; nominal home offsets are conditional priors
No friction, stiffness, backlash or loaded servo response is encoded in these files

floor_clearance_constraint.method: Exact CAD extrema, training episodes only; one-sided floor clearance, no cube or endpoint fitting

encoder_units.method: supplied LeRobot calibration cross-checked against all recorded encoder values
assumptions: Homing offsets are already applied in motor firmware; never add them to normalized recorded states

gripper_response.method: unloaded command-to-observed velocity response; episodes 0-7 fit, 8-9 validate
assumptions: Fit uses measured motion in open gaps, excluding the cube-loaded stall
Torque limit, damping, friction and compliance remain unmeasured
The velocity controller retains physical torque saturation and contact-determined actual jaw motion

limitations: Image-derived calibration and rigid CAD geometry; physical servo/friction/compliance parameters are unmeasured
The first five arm joints remain prescribed from measured states; only the gripper/cube use contact dynamics
Final reference position is reconstructed from both images on an assumed plate plane, not independently surveyed
All contact outcomes and force spikes are retained; matching images does not guarantee matching dynamics

effective_contact_response.method: effective contact-compliance candidate selected by recorded loaded-jaw tracking; no endpoint objective
assumptions: Effective contact compliance represents omitted printed-jaw and arm compliance; not measured PLA stiffness
Existing friction, jaw torque saturation and CAD collision geometry are retained
Later images and final cube positions never drive simulated cube motion
Large contact-force/penetration outliers remain visible and are not used as a calibrated force response

recorded_jaw_floor_clearance.method: Exact extrema of full jaw meshes at recorded measured joint states; no physics or object correction

previous_recorded_jaw_floor_clearance.method: Exact extrema of full jaw meshes at recorded measured joint states; no physics or object correction

assumptions: Metric scale comes from enclosure/mat and CAD dimensions

encoder_scale_constraint.method: integer encoder-grid inference from all 6632 observed states
assumptions: 12-bit STS3215 position encoder, matching the supplied SO follower model
First five columns are consistent with degrees or an equivalent 2275-tick normalized span; either interpretation yields the same angular scale
Gripper remains a calibrated percentage; its inferred span is 1518 ticks
Signs follow CAD axes; absolute offsets are fitted separately
